title: Symmetry of symmetric adjacency
statement: Fix a list of weighted edges on $n$ vertices, and let $u$ and $v$ be two vertices. Recall that $u$ and $v$ are symmetrically adjacent when some edge in the list has $\{u, v\}$ as its pair of endpoints, in either order. If $u$ and $v$ are symmetrically adjacent, then so are $v$ and $u$.
hypotheses_covered: a list of weighted edges on n vertices
u and v are symmetrically adjacent
